notes: Page Style 1 is HELD entirely (see style-2 notes); only page Style 2 ships, so the shipped style keeps its page id 'style-2'. No other brand's system or table was imported: in particular, no CP-number table from any other brand was used for the held Style 1. ANSI/CSA standards-date estimation mentioned on the page is never encoded. Kept separate from Thermo Pride: nothing from the thermo-pride page was used here, and vice versa.

styles.notes: Page: year from the 1st two numerical digits; no month or week rule stated, so year-only. Decoded year derived from the stated positions, not page-stated (1973 under the century rule: 2073 is future). Page Style 1 (CP 5160092) HELD: its rule lives only in chart image WILLIAMSON-Date-of-Manufacture-Serial-Number-Style-1.jpg, which text fetch cannot read, so nothing from it is decoded or guessed. Shape-collision check: the held Style 1 shape (CP + 7 digits) differs from this shipped 7-digit shape, and CP-prefixed serials cannot match ^\d{7}$, so no hold propagates to Style 2.
